personality_one_liner: A clean, premium, and trustworthy Indian kitchenware e-commerce experience featuring deep red accents, dark charcoal typography surfaces, and pristine product photography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, structured touch targets, clean gutters with 16pt safe margins.

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom navigation bar over scrolling product grids.
Apply subtle translucent white tint over dark charcoal cards for featured items.
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or checkout summary cards.
Do not use heavy blur that obscures product thumbnails.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Display TCH branding, voice search, promotional carousel, category shortcuts, and trending Indian kitchenware collections.

states.loading: Skeleton pulse loaders on banner and 2-column product grid.
states.empty: Illustration of kitchenware with prompt to explore categories or reset search.
states.error: Error banner with retry button for catalog fetching.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with TCH logo, location selector, notification badge, and cart badge. Search bar with voice icon. Swipeable promotional banner carousel. Horizontal scrollable category pill chips. 2-column product grid for Best Sellers and Trending Items with MRP, discount badge, star ratings, and Add to Cart button.

screens.name: Categories
screens.purpose: Browse full inventory of crockware, gift items, jar candy jars, cup saucers, dinner sets, and bulk glassware in a structured grid.
screens.layout: Grid layout showing 14 distinct categories with real thumbnail photography, category title, and active item counts. Clicking any category navigates directly to the filtered product listing.

screens.name: Products
screens.purpose: Filterable and sortable 2-column mobile product listing with pagination and stock status indicators.

states.empty: No products match your filter criteria.
states.error: Failed to load products. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Top sticky filter bar with price range, discount, rating, and availability toggles, plus sort sheet dropdown. 2-column product grid with image, title, MRP, selling price, discount tag, stock badge, and Add to Cart button.

screens.name: Product Details
screens.purpose: Comprehensive product view with image gallery, variant selector, specifications, similar items, and reviews.
screens.layout: Zoom-ready image gallery slider with thumbnail pagination. Product name, rating, discounted Indian Rupee pricing (₹), stock availability pill, material & dimension specs, quantity stepper, and sticky bottom bar with Add to Cart and Buy Now buttons. Followed by Similar Products and Customer Reviews.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review selected kitchenware items, update quantities, view detailed order summary with Indian taxes and delivery charges.

states.empty: Cart is empty illustration with 'Start Shopping' CTA.

screens.layout: List of cart items with thumbnail, title, variant, quantity +/- steppers, and remove button. Order summary breakdown (Subtotal, Discount, Delivery, Tax, Grand Total in ₹). Sticky bottom container with Continue Shopping and Proceed to Checkout buttons.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Collect customer details, shipping address, landmark, state, and pincode for Cash on Delivery (COD) orders.
screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form with Full Name, Mobile Number, Email, Address, Landmark, City, State, Pincode. Saved address selector. Delivery summary card and sticky 'Place Order' button.

screens.name: Order Confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirm successful placement of COD order with order ID, date, and admin tools.
screens.layout: Success checkmark animation, Order ID, Order date, delivery estimate, item summary, and WhatsApp order sharing button for admins.

screens.name: Orders
screens.purpose: View order history, track delivery status, and allow admin to manage inventory, delete dispatched orders, or share via WhatsApp.
screens.layout: Chronological list of orders with status badges (Processing, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled). Admin mode toggle for category editing, adding 4-photo product galleries via mobile gallery upload, deleting dispatched orders, and WhatsApp sharing.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Customer and Admin authentication state, saved addresses, app settings, and admin mode access.
screens.layout: User account info card, login/logout toggle for Customer (mobile/email) and Admin (email/password), saved addresses manager, TCH store info, and version details.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready React Native Expo e-commerce app for TCH Kitchenware & Home Products.
Enforce strict iOS-Native Clean styling with deep red brand accents (#DC2626) and dark charcoal background surfaces (#121212 / #1E1E1E).
Implement all 5 bottom tabs: Home, Categories, Products, Orders, and Profile with a prominent cart badge in the header.
Include customer mobile/email authentication and admin email/password login with initial admin account.
Support complete product catalog management: admin can add products with up to 4 gallery images, manage 14 kitchenware categories, delete dispatched or cancelled orders, and share orders on WhatsApp.
All prices must be displayed in Indian Rupees (₹) with clear MRP, selling price, and discount percentage.
Cash on Delivery (COD) checkout flow with full Indian address inputs (Name, Mobile, Address, Landmark, City, State, Pincode).
